description: This file defines the GuarantorRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor for managing Guarantor entities related to loans in the Fineract project. It provides methods to find guarantors by loan and id, or by loan only.

classes.name: GuarantorRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Guarantor entities, enabling CRUD operations and custom queries related to guarantors associated with loans.

methods.name: findByLoanAndId
methods.description: Retrieves a Guarantor entity based on the associated Loan and its id.

methods.name: findByLoan
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Guarantor entities associated with a specific Loan.
